description:
Desktop proxy client powered by Xray core.

Happ is a application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.
• Improved compatibility by updating the Xray core to version 26.9.9
• Improved connection stability：a frozen core now restarts automatically, Xray TUN starts more reliably, and the tunnel recovers properly after waking from sleep on macOS
• Improved premium status reliability, so premium no longer drops after a subscription update
• Improved TUN mode on Windows：tun2proxy now works without administrator rights, and the separate split-tunnel driver is no longer needed
• Improved Per-App Proxy on macOS, which now also catches browsers such as Safari
• Improved startup and subscription refresh speed with large server lists
• Improved QR code scanning, including dense codes such as encrypted subscription links
• Improved support for provider subscription parameters, including fallback links, exclude routes and per-app lists
• Added IPv6 support to Exclude routes, and IPv6 traffic support in Happ TUN
• Added a Block list to Per-App Proxy that cuts off the connections of selected apps
• Added Share Config and Share QR-code to the server menu
• Added a warning when another program interferes with Happ's connection in TUN mode
• Added a Show icon in the Dock option on macOS
• Fixed Proxy mode on macOS not setting the system proxy
• Fixed the connection timer going negative when the time zone changes
• Fixed opening .happ files and links while Happ is already running
• Fixed several routing issues when routing profiles are on and when switching servers
• Fixed import of some VMess and VLESS links
• Fixed a black screen after changing the language in full screen on macOS
• Fixed the QR-Code button on Ubuntu and startup on some Wayland systems
• Minor UI improvements
